Chooses what the emergency alarm does. Local sounds the alarm on this radio only, Send Tone transmits a repeating alarm tone, and Send Code transmits the digits 119 followed by the ANI code.

Controls access to the full front-panel menu. Disabling it can prevent users from changing programmed settings on the radio.
Controls what scanning does after finding a signal. TO resumes after a preset time, CO resumes after the signal disappears, and SE stops scanning on the detected frequency or channel.
Controls what scanning does after finding a signal. Time resumes after a preset time, Carrier resumes after the signal disappears, and Search stops scanning on the detected frequency or channel.
Controls when the ANI code is sent: BOT when PTT is pressed, EOT when PTT is released, Both at both times, or Off.

Controls whether the radio's front-panel RESET menu is available. This does not reset the radio by itself.

Cuts standby power consumption by switching the receiver off and on in a repeating cycle once no signal has been received for a few seconds. It considerably extends battery life, at the cost of occasionally clipping the first moment of an incoming transmission.

Limits how long a single transmission may last. When the time runs out the radio stops transmitting until PTT is released, which prevents overheating and stops a stuck PTT from blocking the channel for everyone else.
